name: Flowise
desc: Drag-and-drop LangChain flow builder, acquired by Workday
desc_zh: 拖拽式 LangChain 流程搭建工具，2025-08 被 Workday 收购
solves: You wire a LangChain chain by editing nested Python objects until the shape is unreadable. It draws the graph instead and exports it.
solves_zh: 接一条 LangChain 链要靠改嵌套的 Python 对象，改到后来结构自己也读不懂了。它改成让你画这张图，再导出代码。
best_for: When a team wants to design and hand off an agent flow without reading raw Python.
best_for_zh: 当团队要设计并交付一条智能体流程，却不想读原始 Python 代码时。
